name: ogsr-fidelityfx-fsr3
description: AMD FidelityFX SDK fork used by OGSR Engine (OGSR/FidelityFX-SDK, branch release-FSR3-3.1.4-ogsr): upstream SDK 1.1.4 with the FSR 3.1.4 upscaler, FSR3 frame generation (DX12: frame interpolation, optical flow, proxy swap chain) and DX11 (metarutaiga) / DX12 backends as static libraries, with the fork's prebuilt shader blobs.
